# joule AI

> joule AI is coming soon. its tagline is "less managing, more doing". this site is a one-page waitlist.

## pages

- [home](https://jouleai.vercel.app/): the waitlist form, an optional 6-question survey after signup, an invite link, and a short faq.

## key facts

- name: joule AI
- status: coming soon; the waitlist is open
- how to join: enter your email on the home page and press "join waitlist"
- invites: after you join, you get a personal invite link; when someone joins the waitlist through it, you get 2 months free
- contact: tryjoule.ai@gmail.com
